task.question: How many people are reported missing in Tibet after the floods in August 2026?
task.evidence: August 26 – 2026 Nepal–Tibet floods: At least 1,130 people are killed and nearly 4,500 reported missing in Tibet Autonomous Region after a flash flood strikes between Tibet and Nepal.

answer:
Reports indicate that at least 403 people are missing in connection with the flash floods in Tibet after the events in August 2026, including many international tourists. 

FINAL: 403

How many people are reported missing in Tibet after the floods in August 2026?

[Flash floods on Nepal-Tibet border leave scores dead and hundreds missing] At least 157 people dead and hundreds of tourists among missing after roads, bridges and power plants swept away Nepal-Tibet flash floods – live updates (https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/aug/26/major-casualties-feared-after-flash-floods-along-nepal-tibet-border)

At least 157 people have been killed and hundreds, including large numbers of foreign tourists, are missing after flash floods ⁠hit the Himalayan border areas of ⁠Nepal and Tibet in China, police have said, with parts of India also at risk.
Officials in Nepal said 403 people, including 341 from foreign countries including India, the US, the UK, Australia, South Korea and Malaysia, had been reported missing in the country.
Nepal’s tourism board said more than 100 of those missing were religious tourists from India and the Indian diaspora on a pilgrimage to Mount Kailash in Tibet, a sacred site for Hindus. At least 62 missing Nepali citizens were among hundreds of locals trekking in Rasuwa, one of the worst hit districts.

Reports indicate that at least 403 people are missing in connection with the flash floods in Tibet after the events in August 2026, including many international tourists. 

FINAL: 403
